events.title: Studio Walk-In Office Hour
events.description:
Studio is the heart of the Cornell Tech experience. At roughly a quarter of your coursework, it's where you'll take on real problems for real companies, build products, and learn what it takes to launch a venture in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. A little prep over the summer will help you start strong in the fall.

To get you ready, we're hosting a Studio Summer Office Hour on July 17 from 12:00pm-12:50pm in Tata 141. Stop by with your questions about what Studio is and how to make the most of it.

events.description:

Space is limited, and registration is required.

events.description:

Working with the law firm of Miller Mayer, we offer the presentation every fall and spring semester. Check out International Services' Visas After Graduation page: https://international.globallearning.cornell.edu/maintaining-your-status/visas-after-graduation.
